content.title: Mortgage Broker 101 – What They REALLY Do & Why It Matters
content.text: Navigating the mortgage industry can feel overwhelming, but understanding its core components is essential for anyone considering a career as a loan officer or starting a mortgage company. This video provides an insightful crash course on Mortgage Broker 101, breaking down the various types of mortgage companies and clarifying key industry terms. We’ll explore five major players in the mortgage space: traditional banks, retail mortgage lenders, brokers, correspondent lenders, and wholesale lenders. Each has unique characteristics that influence how we approach our careers in this field. By the end of this video, we will be equipped with confidence and clarity to make informed decisions. If you’re curious about how we can help you simplify your operations beyond what our videos offer and want to know how you can make launching or running your brokerage stress-free, the link below explains everything. No fluff, no “exclusive training” gimmicks—just a straightforward way to see how we work with brokers to take backend tasks off their plates.
